new_libraries.name: Waveshare_TFT_Touch
new_libraries.author: Tedd OKANO
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for the Waveshare 2.8inch TFT Touch Shield (SKU: 10684; ST7789V LCD + XPT2046 touch)
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides ST7789V graphics primitives and XPT2046 resistive touch reading over the shield's shared hardware SPI bus. Pin mapping is fixed by the shield's own PCB (D3/D4/D7/D9/D10, Arduino Uno R3 header form factor) so no wiring configuration is needed.
